minutes.headline: Committee aired competing building plans and agreed to compile them; no vote taken, minutes approval failed for lack of quorum.
minutes.summary: The committee discussed a draft position paper on records storage and digitization, then how to prioritize space needs. Members presented individual "King for a Day" scenarios for town offices, school offices, the Ritter building, Town Hall, PACT, TC Passios and Turkey Hill. The chair will compile the written scenarios for the next meeting; a motion to approve the May 16 minutes was dropped because too few members had read them or attended.

what_happened.line: The committee took no votes; its members each described a preferred plan for town offices, schools, Town Hall and other buildings, and the chair will compile them.
A motion to approve the May 16 minutes was dropped because too few members had read them or attended, so the minutes remain unapproved.
The committee wants a cost target set by the town, and the chair will take that request to the Select Board.
The chair will email a draft position paper on records storage and digitization for approval between meetings and keep it on the next agenda.
Members raised debt capacity for a Turkey Hill replacement, code-upgrade costs at TC Passios, and whether to fund a PACT studio before the cable agreement ends.

why_it_matters: No building plan, cost ceiling or debt figure has been set, so any future request for borrowing for town offices or a Turkey Hill replacement is still undefined.
Which building is reused or replaced, and how much debt it would need, affects the debt limit and the future tax bill, and residents may be asked to vote on it.
watch_next: Next meeting planned for June 27, when the chair is to bring the compiled written scenarios and look for common ground.
The Select Board's answer on whether the town will set a cost goal post for the committee.
